assessment: Git correctly reports actual whitespace bytes. For44 retained raw logs these bytes are captured evidence, including failed runs and terminal/upstream output, not defects to normalize in active source. Two sealed report EOF blanks are real editorial formatting, but their released bytes are already pinned. The exact46path exception preserves those identities without exempting source, fixtures, tests, assertion logic or ordinary new prose.

recommended_scope.existing_precedent: Current .gitattributes uses -whitespace on exact immutable upstream license copies; this is a separately documented evidence-preservation use.
recommended_scope.future_mutation_contract: These exact files remain sealed artifacts. Future source/editorial text must use separate files and ordinary whitespace checks; hash checks must continue rejecting any changed retained byte.

publication_follow_up: Primary should apply only these exact attributes, inspect/check the exact46 attributes and rerun staged diff --check; preserve the initial failed command receipt and verify all46 recorded hashes stay equal. Attribute mutation and staged verification are not executed by this reviewer.
limits: This reviews byte preservation and exact path scope only, not renewed substantive acceptance of any historical failed command or report. No code/test/validation assertion is waived.
